targets.review_note: Build a balanced spatial tree over all coordinates that can be inserted, but activate each leaf only when its insertion actually occurs. Queries prune inactive subtrees and bounding boxes whose exact Manhattan lower bound cannot improve the incumbent; leaf distances determine the answer, so future inactive points never affect outputs. For maximum distance maintain extrema of x+y and x-y. Duplicate points can be deduplicated because neither minimum nor maximum depends on multiplicity. The tree is balanced independently of insertion order and all processing preserves query chronology.
